notes: New: the console shelf now shows a per-game stats preview — completion %, caught/total, badges, team, and shinies — right on the shelf panel. Also includes the built-in Windows emulator (play GB/GBC/GBA games in-app with sound + volume, controller support, remappable keyboard/gamepad controls, selectable fast-forward, and fullscreen; saves are written next to your ROM) and the upgraded save sync that shows Trainer name, Trainer ID + Secret ID, and caught/total, then auto-fills your Pokedex. Android still uses external emulators.
